serial.cpu_model: Unknown in original worker/manifest records; not inferred from the current host.
serial.timing_scope: Parent process launch through communicate/reap, including initialization and four exact queries.
serial.scheduling_scope: One grid worker at a time; other host workloads were not excluded.
serial.memory_scope: Recorded VmHWM is a query-end high-water snapshot, not a separately measured lifetime maximum.

n36.timing_scope: Frozen grid cold-worker operations; parent launch through communicate/reap.
n36.scheduling_scope: New concurrent-worker campaign; paired methods share the assigned CPU within each repetition.
n36.comparability: New N=36 observations remain a separate execution batch from the historical serial grid.

hash_policy: Distributed bytes checked against sha256; embedded pre-sanitization identities checked against original_sha256.
limitations: Exact recorded integer consistency is reproduced; mathematical kernels are not rerun.
Stage medians are separately aggregated and need not sum to the median total.
